assumptions: The strength model is the one score_rbs reports, folded under Turner 2004.
A bacterial host matching the model's anti-SD sequence.
limits: Hits a relative strength, not an absolute protein yield.
The search is over Shine-Dalgarno and spacer; the CDS's own 5' end is not recoded.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The RBS tab shows the designed 5′UTR with its predicted strength, ΔG, spacing and whether it reached the target, and writes no sentence over them; the strength reading belongs to score_rbs, which carries one.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which 5'UTR puts a CDS's translation initiation at a target strength?

description: Design a 5'UTR (Shine-Dalgarno + spacer) in front of a CDS to hit a target translation-initiation strength (SC-08 engine, Turner-2004 folding).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds.description: the CDS starting at its start codon; unset = the open record's sequence.

target_strength.description: target relative strength, on the model's own scale — 1 is as strong as its reference site, and real sites do score above it.

upstream.description: upstream context 5' of the UTR (engine default when unset). Advanced.

name: design_rbs

achievableMax.description: the strongest relative strength any candidate site reached in this search, which bounds what a target above it can get

achievableMin.description: the weakest relative strength any candidate site reached in this search, which bounds what a target below it can get

dgTotal.description: the predicted total free energy of translation initiation (ΔG_total, kcal/mol) for the designed site; null when the model could not fold it

onTarget.description: whether the target strength was reachable
